artifact_records = []
def artifact(artifact_id, name, expected_files):
    directory = ROOT / 'artifacts' / str(artifact_id)
    metadata = read(directory / 'metadata.json')
    acquisition = read(directory / 'download-integrity.json')
    assert metadata['id'] == artifact_id and metadata['name'] == name and not metadata['expired']
    assert metadata['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == SHA and metadata['workflow_run']['id'] == RUN
    assert acquisition['artifact_id'] == artifact_id and acquisition['source_sha'] == SHA and acquisition['run_id'] == RUN
    assert acquisition['complete'] and acquisition['zip_crc_valid']
    # download_attempts is producer bookkeeping, not an independent HTTP trace.
    actual = ref(directory / 'archive.zip')
    assert actual['bytes'] == metadata['size_in_bytes'] == acquisition['bytes']
    assert 'sha256:' + actual['sha256'] == metadata['digest']
    assert actual['sha256'] == acquisition['sha256']
    with zipfile.ZipFile(directory / 'archive.zip') as archive:
        members = safe_zip(archive)
        assert len(members) == expected_files
    ledger_path = directory / 'extracted-file-index.json'
    ledger = read(ledger_path)
    assert len(ledger) == expected_files and len({row['path'] for row in ledger}) == expected_files
    assert {row['path'] for row in ledger} == {
        path.relative_to(directory / 'extracted').as_posix()
        for path in (directory / 'extracted').rglob('*') if path.is_file()}
    for row in ledger:
        value = ref(directory / 'extracted' / row['path'])
        assert (row['bytes'], row['sha256']) == (value['bytes'], value['sha256'])
    assert digest(ledger_path) == acquisition['derived_index_sha256']
    artifact_records.append({'metadata': metadata, 'original_acquisition_receipt': acquisition,
                             'verified_archive': actual, 'derived_index': ref(ledger_path),
                             'extracted_file_count': len(ledger)})
    return directory / 'extracted'

def digest(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def ref(p):return {'path':str(p.resolve()),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(p)}
def as_list(v):return v if isinstance(v,list) else [v]
def text(p):
    b=p.read_bytes()
    return b.decode('utf-16') if b[:2] in (b'\xff\xfe',b'\xfe\xff') else b.decode('utf-8-sig')
artifact_records=[]
def artifact(id, name):
    base=ROOT/'artifacts'/str(id)
    meta=read(base/'metadata.json');receipt=read(base/'download-integrity.json')
    assert meta['name']==name and meta['workflow_run']['head_sha']==SHA and meta['workflow_run']['id']==RUN
    assert receipt['complete'] and receipt['download_attempts']==1 and receipt['zip_crc_valid']
    assert meta['digest']=='sha256:'+digest(base/'archive.zip')
    ledger=read(base/'extracted-file-index.json')
    assert len(ledger)==len({r['path'] for r in ledger})
    assert {r['path'] for r in ledger}=={p.relative_to(base/'extracted').as_posix() for p in (base/'extracted').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    for row in ledger:
        p=base/'extracted'/row['path']
        assert p.stat().st_size==row['bytes'] and digest(p)==row['sha256']
    artifact_records.append({'metadata':meta,'acquisition':receipt,'derived_index':ref(base/'extracted-file-index.json')})
    return base/'extracted'

"""Read full CTest LastTest sections without replacing original JUnit records."""
import re

def parse_lasttest(text):
    text = text.replace('\r\n','\n')
    headers = list(re.finditer(r'^(\d+)/(\d+) Testing: (.+)$',text,re.M))
    assert headers, 'No LastTest test sections'
    result = {}
    for i, header in enumerate(headers):
        name = header.group(3)
        assert name not in result, ('Duplicate LastTest test name',name)
        section = text[header.end():headers[i+1].start() if i+1<len(headers) else len(text)]
        match = re.search(r'^Output:\n-+\n(.*?)^<end of output>\n(.*)',section,re.M|re.S)
        assert match, ('Incomplete LastTest output section',name)
        body, suffix = match.groups()
        assert re.search(r'^Test (?:Passed|Failed|Not Run|Skipped)\.',suffix,re.M), ('No LastTest outcome',name)
        result[name] = {'number':int(header.group(1)),'total':int(header.group(2)),
                        'text':body,'passed':bool(re.search(r'^Test Passed\.',suffix,re.M)),
                        'outcome_suffix':suffix}
    return result

def digest(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()

"""Read full CTest LastTest sections without replacing original JUnit records."""
import re

def parse_lasttest(text):
    text = text.replace('\r\n','\n')
    headers = list(re.finditer(r'^(\d+)/(\d+) Testing: (.+)$',text,re.M))
    assert headers, 'No LastTest test sections'
    result = {}
    for i, header in enumerate(headers):
        name = header.group(3)
        assert name not in result, ('Duplicate LastTest test name',name)
        section = text[header.end():headers[i+1].start() if i+1<len(headers) else len(text)]
        match = re.search(r'^Output:\n-+\n(.*?)^<end of output>\n(.*)',section,re.M|re.S)
        assert match, ('Incomplete LastTest output section',name)
        body, suffix = match.groups()
        assert re.search(r'^Test (?:Passed|Failed|Not Run|Skipped)\.',suffix,re.M), ('No LastTest outcome',name)
        result[name] = {'number':int(header.group(1)),'total':int(header.group(2)),
                        'text':body,'passed':bool(re.search(r'^Test Passed\.',suffix,re.M)),
                        'outcome_suffix':suffix}
    return result

            output.write(block);hasher.update(block);size += len(block)
    receipt.update(bytes=size,sha256=hasher.hexdigest())
    assert size == meta['size_in_bytes'], 'Artifact size mismatch'
    assert 'sha256:'+hasher.hexdigest() == meta['digest'], 'Artifact API digest mismatch'
    with zipfile.ZipFile(temporary) as z:
        members = z.infolist()
        assert len({r.filename for r in members}) == len(members), 'Duplicate ZIP member'
        for r in members:
            name = PurePosixPath(r.filename)
            assert not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts and '\\' not in r.filename
            assert not stat.S_ISLNK(r.external_attr >> 16)
        assert z.testzip() is None, 'ZIP CRC failure'
        os.replace(temporary,final)
        extract.mkdir()
        z.extractall(extract)
        receipt.update(zip_members=len(members),zip_crc_valid=True,zip_path=final.name,extracted_path=extract.name)
    ledger=[]
    for p in sorted(extract.rglob('*')):
        if p.is_file():
            h=hashlib.sha256()
            with p.open('rb') as stream:
                for chunk in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(chunk)
            ledger.append({'path':p.relative_to(extract).as_posix(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':h.hexdigest()})
    (root/'extracted-file-index.json').write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
    original = extract/'SHA256SUMS.json'
    receipt['original_index_present'] = original.is_file()
    if original.is_file():
        declared = json.loads(original.read_text())
        assert len({r['path'] for r in declared}) == len(declared)
        actual = [r for r in ledger if r['path'] != 'SHA256SUMS.json']
        assert {r['path'] for r in declared} == {r['path'] for r in actual}
        assert {r['path']:(r['bytes'],r['sha256']) for r in declared} == {r['path']:(r['bytes'],r['sha256']) for r in actual}
        receipt.update(original_index_verified=True,original_index_sha256=hashlib.sha256(original.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),original_indexed_files=len(declared))
    receipt.update(complete=True,extracted_files=len(ledger),derived_index_sha256=hashlib.sha256((root/'extracted-file-index.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
except BaseException as error:
    receipt['error'] = type(error).__name__+': '+str(error)
    raise
finally:
    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2))

# RavenForge / Chimera MSIX

Publisher display name: **RavenForge Luthier Intelligence**.

## What this package installs

The MSIX contains the x64 standalone instrument, both factory cabinet IRs, RavenForge
artwork and notices. Windows 10 version 2004 (19041) or later is required for the
release manifest. `win32App` / `mediumIL` preserves normal desktop audio operation
and the existing external user IR/preferences locations; the app is not converted
into an AppContainer. `runFullTrust` and microphone use are declared.

MSIX deployment does not copy its private files into an unrelated DAW's global
`Common Files/VST3` folder. Use the existing Setup installer for the VST3 plugin.
The MSIX does not silently launch an elevated second installer or claim that a
VST3 hidden under WindowsApps is discoverable by Studio One.

In the standalone app, use **IR LIBRARY > IMPORT PERSONAL ZIP** to import the
existing personal IR archive once, or **ADD FOLDER** to register another folder.
The private TONE3000 captures are excluded from Store/public packages. The private
EXE installer companion bundle still installs those six IRs automatically.

## Current review package

`Chimera-1.0.0.0-x64-review-unsigned.msix` is a real SDK-generated package for
inspection, not an authenticated customer release. It has no Store assignment
and no trusted signature, so ordinary double-click installation is not promised.
No customer certificate/root installation or disabling of Windows protections is
part of this delivery.

Build with the tested Windows portable artifact as input:

```powershell
./Tools/Build-WindowsMSIX.ps1 -Stage C:/Chimera/validated-package
```

`MakeAppx pack` performs manifest schema/semantic validation and SHA256 block-map
generation. CI verifies the checksum, round-trip executable bytes, branding and
package scope, then installs/activates/removes the same payload under a distinct
Microsoft-documented unsigned test identity on its disposable Windows runner.
That test package is deleted and never delivered. The test does not grant a
trusted publisher or constitute Windows App Certification Kit / Store approval.

## Microsoft Store signing route

Microsoft re-signs accepted MSIX packages after Store certification. Purchasing
a separate code-signing certificate is not required for this route.

Reserve the app in the publisher's Partner Center account and copy the exact
values from **Product management > Product identity** into a local JSON file:

```json
{
  "Name": "COPY_PACKAGE_IDENTITY_NAME_FROM_PARTNER_CENTER",
  "Publisher": "COPY_PACKAGE_IDENTITY_PUBLISHER_FROM_PARTNER_CENTER",
  "PublisherDisplayName": "RavenForge Luthier Intelligence"
}
```

These are non-secret package identity fields; do not supply passwords, certificate
private keys or account recovery codes. The review identity is not invented Store
registration. The build refuses Store mode without the actual identity file.

```powershell
./Tools/Build-WindowsMSIX.ps1 -Stage C:/Chimera/validated-package -Mode Store -IdentityFile C:/Chimera/partner-identity.json -Version 1.0.0.0
```

Run the Windows App Certification Kit on the resulting package and a supported
interactive Windows client, verify real audio input/output, then submit that exact
package through the matching app in Partner Center. Explain `runFullTrust`: this
is a native JUCE audio instrument using desktop audio devices and local IR files;
it does not install drivers/services or require administrator rights to play.

Account identity, listing/privacy/support information, certification and release
have not been submitted or approved. No Store listing or commercial acceptance
is implied by the local packaging tests.

## Direct MSIX distribution

Outside the Store, a trusted code-signing certificate is still needed:

```powershell
$env:CHIMERA_SIGNING_THUMBPRINT = '40_HEXADECIMAL_CHARACTERS_FROM_THE_ISSUED_CERTIFICATE'
./Tools/Build-WindowsMSIX.ps1 -Stage C:/Chimera/validated-package -Mode Signed
```

This derives the full manifest Publisher distinguished name from the certificate,
requires its verified display identity to match RavenForge Luthier Intelligence,
signs the executable and MSIX, timestamps them and verifies trust. A missing or
invalid identity stops the release. See `WINDOWS_SIGNING.md`.

SpectralForge Chimera — Open Beta 1.3 (1.3.0-beta.1)
Windows 10/11 x64 설치 안내
==================================================

1. Studio One 등 모든 DAW와 Chimera를 종료하고 중요한 프로젝트를 복사해 보관합니다.
2. 받은 ZIP을 전체 해제하고 SpectralForge-Chimera-1.3.0-beta.1-win64-Setup.exe를 실행합니다.
3. VST3, 단독 실행 앱, 선택적 레퍼런스 도구를 선택합니다.
4. VST3의 기본 위치는 C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\SpectralForge Chimera.vst3입니다.
   다른 VST3 폴더를 선택했다면 DAW의 플러그인 검색 경로에도 추가하세요.
5. 단독 실행 앱의 기본 폴더는 기존 개발판 업그레이드를 위해
   C:\Program Files\SpectralForge\Chimera Amp Matrix 경로를 유지합니다.
   실행 파일과 시작 메뉴 이름은 SpectralForge Chimera입니다.
6. 시작 메뉴의 Manual 또는 앱 SETTINGS의 Manual에서 한국어/영어 오프라인 매뉴얼을 엽니다.
7. DAW를 다시 실행하고 필요하면 VST3를 재검색합니다.

이 베타 테스트 설치 파일은 퍼블리셔 코드서명 전입니다. 코드서명 또는 Windows Store
인증이 완료되었다는 의미가 아니며, 브라우저/Windows 경고가 나타날 수 있습니다.
다운로드 파일의 SHA256을 동봉된 해시와 비교하세요. 시스템 보안을 끄지 마세요.
바이너리는 MSVC 런타임을 정적으로 연결하므로 별도 VC++ 런타임 설치는 필요 없습니다.

업데이트 / 복구 / 제거
- 같은 Setup을 다시 실행하면 패키지 소유 파일을 복구합니다.
- 기존 AppId와 제거 항목을 유지합니다. 정확한 기존 실행 파일과 기존 VST3 바이너리만
  교체 대상이며 사용자 프리셋, IR과 프로젝트는 삭제하지 않습니다.
- 다른 폴더에 수동 복사한 이전 버전은 자동으로 삭제하지 않습니다.
- 이미 설치된 구성 요소를 선택 해제하는 것만으로 제거되지는 않습니다.
  필요한 경우 앱을 제거한 다음 원하는 구성 요소만 선택합니다.
- Windows 설정 > 설치된 앱 > SpectralForge Chimera에서 제거합니다.

IR
- 기본 IR 목록에는 출처와 이용 조건을 기록한 내장 factory IR 2개가 포함됩니다.
  상세 출처와 라이선스는 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md와 IR_DISTRIBUTION.md에서 확인합니다.
- 재배포 근거를 확인하지 못한 외부·개인 참조 항목과 개발용 레퍼런스 음원은
  기본 목록과 배포 패키지에서 제외합니다.
- 직접 보유한 WAV/AIFF는 IR LIBRARY의 OPEN IR로 선택하거나 ADD FOLDER로 등록합니다.
  Setup 옆에 개인 IR 팩을 놓는 방식으로는 자동 등록되지 않습니다.
- 이미 등록한 사용자 IR 폴더와 프로젝트에 저장된 IR 오디오·메타데이터는 유지합니다.
  업데이트와 제거 과정에서 개인 IR 파일과 프리셋을 삭제하지 않습니다.
- 48개 팩토리 프리셋은 새 modeled CAB 조합을 사용하며 개인 IR 파일을 자동 검색하지 않습니다.
- IR을 해당 리그의 CAB에서 선택해야 소리에 적용됩니다. Matrix LOW는 DI/AMP가

def digest(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

def ref(path):
    return {'path': str(path.resolve()), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size, 'sha256': digest(path)}

def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))

def text(path):
    value = path.read_bytes()
    return value.decode('utf-16') if value[:2] in (b'\xff\xfe', b'\xfe\xff') else value.decode('utf-8-sig')

def as_list(value):
    return value if isinstance(value, list) else [value]

def new_json(path, value):
    assert not path.exists(), 'Refuse to replace frozen audit: ' + str(path)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')

def safe_zip(archive):
    members = archive.infolist()
    assert len({m.filename for m in members}) == len(members)
    for member in members:
        path = PurePosixPath(member.filename)
        assert not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts and '\\' not in member.filename
        assert not stat.S_ISLNK(member.external_attr >> 16)
    assert archive.testzip() is None
    return members

    actual = ref(directory / 'archive.zip')
    assert actual['bytes'] == metadata['size_in_bytes'] == acquisition['bytes']
    assert 'sha256:' + actual['sha256'] == metadata['digest']
    assert actual['sha256'] == acquisition['sha256']
    with zipfile.ZipFile(directory / 'archive.zip') as archive:
        members = safe_zip(archive)
        assert len(members) == expected_files
    ledger_path = directory / 'extracted-file-index.json'
    ledger = read(ledger_path)
    assert len(ledger) == expected_files and len({row['path'] for row in ledger}) == expected_files

"""Read full CTest LastTest sections without replacing original JUnit records."""
import re

def parse_lasttest(text):
    text = text.replace('\r\n','\n')
    headers = list(re.finditer(r'^(\d+)/(\d+) Testing: (.+)$',text,re.M))
    assert headers, 'No LastTest test sections'
    result = {}
    for i, header in enumerate(headers):
        name = header.group(3)
        assert name not in result, ('Duplicate LastTest test name',name)
        section = text[header.end():headers[i+1].start() if i+1<len(headers) else len(text)]
        match = re.search(r'^Output:\n-+\n(.*?)^<end of output>\n(.*)',section,re.M|re.S)
        assert match, ('Incomplete LastTest output section',name)
        body, suffix = match.groups()
        assert re.search(r'^Test (?:Passed|Failed|Not Run|Skipped)\.',suffix,re.M), ('No LastTest outcome',name)
        result[name] = {'number':int(header.group(1)),'total':int(header.group(2)),
                        'text':body,'passed':bool(re.search(r'^Test Passed\.',suffix,re.M)),
                        'outcome_suffix':suffix}
    return result

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One-owner, one-attempt artifact acquisition; never executes artifact content."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import stat
import sys
import urllib.request
import uuid
import zipfile

SOURCE = '47345c81db8aefbf9ae51a2684d546119bb9ae32'
RUNS = {'dedicated':38091545218, 'product':38091545238, 'candidate':38091545225}
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--metadata', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--kind', choices=RUNS, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
meta = json.loads(args.metadata.read_text())
root = args.metadata.parent
assert meta['workflow_run']['id'] == RUNS[args.kind]
assert meta['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == SOURCE and not meta['expired']
assert meta['digest'].startswith('sha256:')
receipt_path = root/'download-integrity.json'
assert not receipt_path.exists(), 'Refuse a second download attempt'
final, extract = root/'archive.zip', root/'extracted'
assert not final.exists() and not extract.exists()
temporary = root/('archive.partial-'+uuid.uuid4().hex)
receipt = {'artifact_id':meta['id'], 'artifact_name':meta['name'], 'source_sha':SOURCE,
    'run_id':RUNS[args.kind], 'download_attempts':1, 'complete':False,
    'remote_digest':meta['digest'], 'temporary_name':temporary.name}
receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
try:
    url = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    assert url.startswith('https://')
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Chimera-evidence-audit'})
    hasher, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=60) as response, temporary.open('xb') as output:
        while True:
            block = response.read(1024*1024)
            if not block:
                break
            output.write(block);hasher.update(block);size += len(block)
    receipt.update(bytes=size,sha256=hasher.hexdigest())
    assert size == meta['size_in_bytes'], 'Artifact size mismatch'
    assert 'sha256:'+hasher.hexdigest() == meta['digest'], 'Artifact API digest mismatch'
    with zipfile.ZipFile(temporary) as z:
        members = z.infolist()
        assert len({r.filename for r in members}) == len(members), 'Duplicate ZIP member'
        for r in members:
            name = PurePosixPath(r.filename)
            assert not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts and '\\' not in r.filename
            assert not stat.S_ISLNK(r.external_attr >> 16)
        assert z.testzip() is None, 'ZIP CRC failure'
        os.replace(temporary,final)
        extract.mkdir()
        z.extractall(extract)
        receipt.update(zip_members=len(members),zip_crc_valid=True,zip_path=final.name,extracted_path=extract.name)
    ledger=[]
    for p in sorted(extract.rglob('*')):
        if p.is_file():
            h=hashlib.sha256()
            with p.open('rb') as stream:
                for chunk in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(chunk)
            ledger.append({'path':p.relative_to(extract).as_posix(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':h.hexdigest()})
    (root/'extracted-file-index.json').write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
    original = extract/'SHA256SUMS.json'
    receipt['original_index_present'] = original.is_file()
    if original.is_file():
        declared = json.loads(original.read_text())
        assert len({r['path'] for r in declared}) == len(declared)
        actual = [r for r in ledger if r['path'] != 'SHA256SUMS.json']
        assert {r['path'] for r in declared} == {r['path'] for r in actual}
        assert {r['path']:(r['bytes'],r['sha256']) for r in declared} == {r['path']:(r['bytes'],r['sha256']) for r in actual}
        receipt.update(original_index_verified=True,original_index_sha256=hashlib.sha256(original.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),original_indexed_files=len(declared))
    receipt.update(complete=True,extracted_files=len(ledger),derived_index_sha256=hashlib.sha256((root/'extracted-file-index.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
except BaseException as error:
    receipt['error'] = type(error).__name__+': '+str(error)
    raise
finally:
    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')

$startMenu = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath("CommonPrograms")) "SpectralForge\SpectralForge Chimera"

function Assert([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message) {

function Run-SetupProcess([string]$Executable, [string[]]$Parameters) {
    # Inno's uninstaller spawns a second phase. Wait for the whole process tree,
    # not just the launcher, before another install can reuse the same directory.
    $process = Start-Process -FilePath $Executable -ArgumentList $Parameters -PassThru -Wait

function Install([string]$Name, [string]$Destination, [string]$Components, [string]$Vst3Directory = "") {

        $parameters += "/VST3DIR=`"$Vst3Directory`""

function Equal-File([string]$Source, [string]$Destination) {
    Assert (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Destination -PathType Leaf) "Missing installed file: $Destination"
    Assert ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Source).Hash -eq (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Destination).Hash) "Installed bytes differ: $Destination"
}
function Equal-Tree([string]$Source, [string]$Destination) {
    foreach ($file in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Source -Recurse -File) {
        Equal-File $file.FullName (Join-Path $Destination ([IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($Source, $file.FullName)))
    }
}
function Check-Payload([string]$Destination, [bool]$Vst3, [bool]$Standalone, [bool]$Reference) {
    if ($Vst3) { Equal-Tree (Join-Path $stagePath "VST3/SpectralForge Chimera.vst3") $vst }
    else { Assert (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $vst)) "Unselected VST3 was installed" }
    $exe = Join-Path $Destination "SpectralForge Chimera.exe"
    if ($Standalone) {
        Equal-File (Join-Path $stagePath "Standalone/SpectralForge Chimera.exe") $exe
        $shortcut = Join-Path $startMenu "SpectralForge Chimera.lnk"
        Assert (Test-Path -LiteralPath $shortcut) "Start Menu shortcut is missing"
        # Keep launchable shortcuts on the disposable test machine. The report
        # records the real launch result below; it must not redistribute .lnk files.
    } else {
        Assert (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) "Unselected standalone app was installed"
        Assert (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $startMenu "SpectralForge Chimera.lnk"))) "Unselected standalone shortcut was created"
    }
    foreach ($file in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $stagePath -File) {
        if ($file.Extension -eq ".txt") { Equal-File $file.FullName (Join-Path $Destination $file.Name) }
        if ($file.Extension -in ".md", ".html") { Equal-File $file.FullName (Join-Path $Destination "Documentation/$($file.Name)") }
    }
    Equal-File (Join-Path $stagePath "payload-manifest.json") (Join-Path $Destination "Documentation/payload-manifest.json")
    Assert (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $startMenu "Manual.lnk")) "Offline manual shortcut is missing"
    # Public packages exclude research documents and reference audio. These are
    # payload checks only; user-imported IR locations remain outside this scope.
    foreach ($excluded in @(
        @{ Stage = "reference"; Installed = "Documentation/reference" },
        @{ Stage = "reference-audio"; Installed = "reference-audio" }
    )) {
        Assert (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $stagePath $excluded.Stage))) "Excluded research folder exists in public staging: $($excluded.Stage)"
        Assert (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Destination $excluded.Installed))) "Excluded research folder was installed: $($excluded.Installed)"
    }
    if ($Reference) {
        Equal-Tree (Join-Path $stagePath "ReferenceTools") (Join-Path $Destination "ReferenceTools")
    } else { Assert (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Destination "ReferenceTools"))) "Unselected reference tools were installed" }
    Assert (Test-Path -LiteralPath $registry) "Windows uninstall entry is missing"
    $entry = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $registry
    Assert ($entry.DisplayName -eq "SpectralForge Chimera") "Wrong Windows app name"
    Assert ($entry.DisplayVersion -ceq $payload.installer_version) "Candidate installer version differs from its payload: registry=$($entry.DisplayVersion), payload=$($payload.installer_version)"
    if ($Standalone) { Assert-ChimeraBinaryVersion $exe $payload.product_version }
    if ($Vst3) { Assert-ChimeraBinaryVersion (Join-Path $vst "Contents/x86_64-win/SpectralForge Chimera.vst3") $payload.product_version }
    if ($Reference) { Assert-ChimeraBinaryVersion (Join-Path $Destination "ReferenceTools/ChimeraRender.exe") $payload.product_version }
    $observedVersions.Add($entry.DisplayVersion)
    Pass "Installed DisplayVersion=$($entry.DisplayVersion) and selected binary versions match $($payload.version)"
    Assert ($entry.InstallLocation.TrimEnd([char]92) -eq $Destination.TrimEnd([char]92)) "Wrong registered install location"
}
function Uninstall([string]$Name, [string]$Destination) {

    Assert ($uninstaller.StartsWith((Join-Path $Destination "Uninstall"), [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) "Unexpected uninstaller location"
    Assert (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller) "Uninstaller is missing"
    Run-SetupProcess $uninstaller @("/VERYSILENT", "/SUPPRESSMSGBOXES", "/NORESTART", "/LOG=`"$logPath/$Name.log`"")
    Assert (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $registry)) "Uninstall entry remains"
    Assert (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Destination "SpectralForge Chimera.exe"))) "Standalone app remains"
    Assert (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $vst "Contents/x86_64-win/SpectralForge Chimera.vst3"))) "VST3 binary remains"

using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;
public static class ChimeraInstallProbe {
    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
    public static extern uint GetLongPathName(string path, StringBuilder result, uint length);
}
'@
function Long-Path([string]$Path) {
    $buffer = [Text.StringBuilder]::new(32768)
    $length = [ChimeraInstallProbe]::GetLongPathName($Path, $buffer, $buffer.Capacity)
    Assert ($length -gt 0 -and $length -lt $buffer.Capacity) "Cannot resolve installed path: $Path"
    return $buffer.ToString()
}
function Check-AppShortcut([string]$Destination) {
    # Test the user's actual launch path and compare the launched process's
    # canonical filename, including Unicode and 8.3 path handling.
    $shortcut = Join-Path $startMenu "SpectralForge Chimera.lnk"
    $application = Start-Process -FilePath $shortcut -PassThru
    Assert ($null -ne $application) "Shortcut did not start an application process"
    try {
        for ($attempt = 0; $attempt -lt 60; ++$attempt) {
            $application.Refresh()
            if ($application.HasExited -or $application.MainWindowHandle -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) { break }
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
        }
        Assert (!$application.HasExited -and $application.MainWindowHandle -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) "Shortcut did not open the installed application window"
        $actual = Long-Path $application.MainModule.FileName
        $expected = Long-Path (Join-Path $Destination "SpectralForge Chimera.exe")
        Assert ($actual -eq $expected) "Shortcut launched '$actual'; expected '$expected'"
        Pass "Start Menu shortcut launches the installed app and its window: $actual"
    } finally {
        if (!$application.HasExited) {
            $null = $application.CloseMainWindow()
            if (!$application.WaitForExit(10000)) { $application.Kill($true); $application.WaitForExit() }
        }
    }
}
